query: How do I make a veggie wrap?

goal.title: Prepare a hummus and vegetable wrap
goal.description: Rub and cut the vegetables, spread mixed hummus over a tortilla, layer cucumber lettuce tomato avocado and shredded cheese, then fold, roll and halve the wrap.
goal.final_state: Two cut wrap halves are arranged on a raised serving plate with the vegetable filling visible.

procedure.description: Lift a plate holding lettuce, cucumber and a tomato. Hold a white bowl in the left hand while rubbing and turning the lettuce inside it, return the lettuce to the vegetable plate and retrieve the cucumber.

Roll and rub the cucumber over a white catch plate, replace it and repeat with the tomato. Lift the bowl and rub the tomato inside it, put the bowl and tomato down and move the catch plate aside. Lift and briefly tilt the vegetable plate above the bowl while retaining the produce, then lay the lettuce on the cutting board.

Pick up the patterned chef knife, chop the lettuce crosswise into strips and gather it. Put the cucumber on the board, trim a tip and repeatedly cut it lengthwise into sticks, then retrieve the tomato.

Saw through the tomato to make thick rounds, set the remaining tomato piece aside, halve the rounds and transfer the half-moons to the vegetable plate. Scoop chopped lettuce and cucumber sticks onto the same plate and put the remaining tomato in the white bowl.

Rest the chef knife across the tortilla, bring its serving plate onto the cutting board, retrieve the hummus tub and take the butter knife. Remove the clear lid, peel off the inner film and place both pieces aside.

Hold the tub in the left hand and stir the darker red topping into the orange hummus with the butter knife. Scoop hummus onto the tortilla and repeatedly spread it into a broad strip through the center. Rest the butter knife in the tub, set the tub aside and move the chef knife onto the tomato bowl.

Lift the prepared vegetable plate and use the right fingertips to line cucumber sticks along the spread. Add several handfuls of chopped lettuce, arrange tomato half-moons along the top and return the vegetable plate.
Lift the second ingredient plate and use its spoon to transfer avocado pieces over the tomatoes. Scoop and scatter shredded cheese over the same central filling, then return the plate and spoon.

Lift the near tortilla edge over the filling and pull it snug. Tuck the right and left edges inward while holding the filling enclosed, then roll the bundle forward until the tortilla surrounds the filling.

Retrieve the chef knife and saw crosswise through the wrap while steadying it with the other hand. Rest the knife on the tomato bowl, separate and arrange the two halves with the cut faces visible, then lift and hold the serving plate toward the camera through the final frame.

coarse.instruction: Rub and arrange the whole vegetables
coarse.description: Lift the vegetables, rub lettuce in the white bowl, rub cucumber and tomato over the catch plate, move dishes aside, tilt the vegetable plate over the bowl and place lettuce on the board.
coarse.goal_contribution: Prepares the whole vegetables for cutting; no running faucet or added water is visible.

coarse.instruction: Cut and collect the vegetable filling
coarse.description: Chop lettuce, trim and slice cucumber into sticks, slice and halve tomato rounds, collect the cut vegetables on a plate and place the leftover tomato in a bowl.
coarse.goal_contribution: Provides small lettuce pieces, cucumber sticks and tomato slices for the wrap.
coarse.predictability_reason: After rub and arrange the whole vegetables, cut and collect the vegetable filling is a natural next stage toward prepare a hummus and vegetable wrap.

coarse.description: Reposition the chef knife and tortilla plate, open the hummus tub and peel its seal, stir in the red topping, spread hummus down the tortilla center and set tub and knives aside.

coarse.predictability_reason: After cut and collect the vegetable filling, prepare the tortilla with hummus is a natural next stage toward prepare a hummus and vegetable wrap.

coarse.instruction: Layer vegetables avocado and cheese onto the tortilla
